## Updraft 0.7.0

- **Connectors: let your AI apps read your meetings.** Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Claude Desktop on this PC can now search your meetings and read transcripts and AI notes. Read-only, and off until you turn it on. Go to Settings > Connectors, turn on "Let AI apps search my meetings", and click Connect next to the app. A read log shows what each app looked at.
- **Connectors can search your dictation history too.** A second switch under the first one. Off by default; nothing older than your "Keep history for" setting, and never audio.
- **Save meeting notes to Obsidian.** Pick your vault in Settings > Connectors and every finished meeting's AI notes land there as a Markdown file with title, date and duration. Your own notes are never saved.
- **Faster first word.** Updraft wakes the GPU the moment you press the dictation key, so the first words of a dictation come back sooner. On by default; it never runs while live dictation is on.
- **Snappier Meetings page.** The meetings list stops rescanning itself when files change in a burst.
- **Groundwork for web access.** Settings > Connectors has a "Let web apps connect" row for claude.ai, the Claude phone app and ChatGPT. It's not usable yet (it needs Tailscale, coming next); it stays off and says so.

**To update:** Settings > About > Check for updates.
